messages:
Alice M.: Quick kickoff — we need a 1‑page "Secure Inference Pocket Brief" for field teams by EOD Wed. Scope: security controls (VPC/KMS/HSM), SLA options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), a tiny deploy‑mode decision flow, a 2‑sentence benchmark callout, webinar plug, and inbound routing rules. Who can draft?

Ben P.: I can lead the draft. Will do headline + 3 bullets + CTA + suggested webinar blurb. Need up‑to‑date benchmark numbers and one customer quote (can be anonymized).

Frank SRE: Pulling numbers now. Quick paste (rough, fine to round for the one‑pager):

Frank SRE: ```benchmarks
hosted-llama-7b: p50=120ms, p95=320ms, $/token≈0.0008
dedicated-llama-7b-quant: p50=45ms, p95=110ms, $/token≈0.0005
private-onprem (customer infra): p50=40–200ms, $/token=varies (infra dependent)
```

Carla G.: Messaging note: lead with customer outcome — "Predictable performance for regulated workloads"; subhead: "Choose the deployment that matches your SLA and compliance needs." CTA: "Request a security brief + architecture review." For the webinar, proposed title: "Serving Secure Inference at Scale: Deployments, SLAs and Benchmarks" — 30‑min + 15 Qs.

Emma S.: Routing rules for the lead form (SDR triage):
- If company_size >= 1000 OR industry in {finance, healthcare, gov} -> route to AE-enterprise.
- If compliance_checkbox contains any of {HIPAA, FedRAMP, SOC2} -> route to Solutions Eng (security specialist).
- Otherwise -> SDR + automated one‑pager email.

Emma S.: Also include a field: "deployment_interest" with options: Hosted / Dedicated / Private. If Private selected and "compliance=true" auto-schedule solutions call.

Gary C.: For layout: hero line + 3 columns (Security controls | Performance & Cost | Deployment modes). Add a benchmark callout box with the p50/p95 bullets and an icon. Two tiny FAQs: "Which to pick?" and "What are typical SLAs?" Footer: webinar CTA + content contact (email). I can mock a DI (design iteration) in Figma by tomorrow morning.

Ben P.: Draft headline suggestion: "Secure inference without the ops lift — predictable SLAs, flexible deployments." Short lead paragraph (candidate): "Redwood Inference helps engineering teams serve LLMs with enterprise controls and predictable economics — whether you choose hosted, dedicated, or private deployments."

Alice M.: Nice. Action items: Ben write draft (first pass by Tue noon), Gary mock layout Tue EOD, Frank finalize bench numbers Tue morning, Carla finalize messaging + two one‑liner customer quotes (can be anonymized) Tue afternoon, Emma to add routing snippets to the lead form and share the flow. I'll collate and publish the pocket brief Wed AM and push a launch post + webinar invite Thu.

Frank SRE: I'll confirm numbers + add a short line about variability for on‑prem customers.

Carla G.: I'll propose two qualitative quotes: one about predictable latency and one about compliance readiness.

Emma S.: Will set up routing rules in HubSpot and share a diagram once done. Also adding a new tag "secure-inference" for inbound tracking.

Gary C.: Figma link (placeholder): https://figma.com/file/xyz/secure-inference-pocket (will update).

Ben P.: Drafting now — ping me if you have must‑include legal/compliance words.

Alice M.: Great — short sync Fri if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
